data.name: Yameenah
data.long_meaning: Yameenah is a name that signifies a container or receptacle. It is derived from the Arabic word 'yamīn', meaning right or side. In Islamic context, it can also be interpreted as a symbol of God's protection and care, as the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, 'Verily, Allah has written the provision for each of you in a year's supply, and the son of Adam consumes it in a month, and the provision for each is what he has taken, and the loss is what he has spilled.'
data.spiritual_meaning: Yameenah is a name that signifies the container of Allah's blessings and protection. It is a reminder of Allah's provision and care for His creation.
data.numerology_meaning: Yameenah is a name that resonates with the number 5 in numerology. It signifies change and adaptability, as well as the ability to overcome challenges and obstacles.

in_arabic.name: يَمِينَة
in_arabic.long_meaning: يَمِينَة هي اسم يُشير إلى الحس النبيل الذي يكون متماسكاً على الحق والعدل ويكون مرتاحاً في الدنيا والآخرة، ويتسم بالصِدق والصِرف والكَرَم، ويُعتبر من الأسماء النبوية في الإسلام، حيث يُقال في القرآن الكريم: "وَقَد جَعَلنَاهُ في عِلْمٍ عَليم " (الأنبياء: 86)، ويُعتبر اسم ياميناه من أهم الأسماء الإسلامية التي تحتوي على روح الحداثة والتقدم

in_english.meaning: Righteousness on the right hand and truthfulness
in_english.long_meaning: Yameenah is a name that symbolizes righteousness and truthfulness, as mentioned in the Quran as "We have placed him in knowledge" (Al-Anbiya: 86), Yameenah is considered one of the most important names in Islam that encompasses the spirit of progress and modernity, it is a name that reflects the qualities of a pious and truthful person, and is often associated with qualities such as honesty, sincerity, and integrity, in modern times, Yameenah is becoming increasingly popular as a given name for girls, particularly in Western countries, due to its unique and meaningful nature.
